title: Nullish coalescing
starterCode:
const a = null
const b = undefined
const c = 0
const d = ""
return [a ?? "default", b ?? "default", c ?? "default", d ?? "default"]
solution:
const a = null
const b = undefined
const c = 0
const d = ""
return [a ?? "default", b ?? "default", c ?? "default", d ?? "default"]
hints: ?? only checks null/undefined, not falsy values
0 and "" are not null/undefined so they pass through
